name: Beyond Apocalypse
description: Nitrous tuning, digital vehicle and flight dashboards, first-person rifles, backpacks, zombies, the Hornet, motorcycles, Hangar shopping and F9 player settings for Drive Beyond Horizons.

notes: Corrected native AK iron-sight alignment using its authored sight socket. Other rifles, hip-fire positioning and optic offsets retain their existing setup.
Removed Performance Mode's repeated per-component scenery pass and forced visibility overrides. Native distance culling now remains under the game's control.

Performance Mode retains native LOD, grass and post-processing reductions, skips unchanged settings, and restores previous values when disabled. Gains depend on existing quality settings and the scene; no minimum FPS is promised.
Retained the 1.0.8 nitrous, material, motorcycle and inventory fixes. Personal developer tools remain excluded.
Corrected indirect lighting on nitrous bottles and custom rifles so their textures remain readable in shade. Normal, roughness and metallic maps now load in the correct colour space.
Stage II nitrous emits purple exhaust flames; Stage I retains blue flames. Colour changes follow the active bottle stage.
The native nitrous inspection percentage, fluid name and fill bar use the bottle stage colour: blue or purple.
Replaced the large donor-barrel physics mesh with a compact bottle-sized collider. Pickup/drop restores the matching bottle scale.
Nitrous bottles now mount horizontally with their placement origin between the two bracket feet. The valve and fluid-transfer interaction follow the new model orientation.
Existing boost power, consumption, saved bottle identities, motorcycle setup and personal-menu separation are retained.
Added six refillable nitrous bottles: blue Stage I and purple Stage II, each in 2 L, 5 L and 10 L sizes.
Nitrous is a separate native fluid with normal pouring and transfer controls. Attach bottles to a vehicle using the normal attachment controls, then hold Shift while driving to boost.
Boost strength tapers at high speed and sharp steering, stops under braking or without engine power, and consumes nitrous. Multiple bottles extend supply without stacking force.
Blue exhaust effects accompany boost. Bottles appear as uncommon building loot and can be purchased through Hangar.
Added a compact digital vehicle dashboard with speed, gear, RPM, engine temperature, fluid levels, battery warnings and nitrous supply.
The Hornet has a dedicated flight dashboard with collective, altitude and vertical speed; its existing Shift/Ctrl flight controls are retained.
Retained 1.0.6 motorcycle seating, modular headlights, performance controls, weapons, backpacks and other existing fixes. Personal developer tools are excluded.
Updated for Drive Beyond Horizons build 26106988 while retaining established vehicle, inventory, input and Hangar fixes.
F9 opens player settings, statistics and host zombie population controls (2 to 40). Default targets are 5 by day and 10 at night or around an infested building.
Bounded scenery updates replace repeated world-wide mesh scans; idle input and trailer searches are reduced.
Both motorcycles retain corrected rider positioning, stable parked wheels and contact-height presentation. Removable bike-shaped headlights use the native car lighting system.
Hornet pitch, roll and yaw remain enabled after resting on the ground; the manual collective gauge updates smoothly between flight calculations.
Restored rotor-blade pickup recovery, replicated service-part fitting, Hangar click safeguards and saved control reconciliation.
Public gameplay files only. Mod Manager is optional; the game can be launched directly through Steam.
Refined both motorcycles, rider positioning and removable headlights.
Improved Hangar purchases, backpack handling and saved keybinds.
Smoother Performance Mode updates and lighter weapon audio loading.
Improved engine fitting and rotor-blade pickup.
Refined the compact Suzuki PV 50 with fitted service parts, corrected grip targets and clearer detailed metal finishes.
Hold X while riding either motorcycle to gradually raise the front up to 35 degrees; release X to lower it.
Hangar computer setup now retries while loading, and custom orders use the native Buy callback across computers.
Includes saved F8 Performance Mode, both rare motorcycle loot variants, all three repaired rifles and the existing 1.0.4 fixes. Everyone in co-op should update and restart.
Added editable melee controls in F8, ammo cartons, small zombie ammo drops, and uncommon ammunition near loose rifles.
Hangar ammunition is 30 rounds for $300; guest orders, parcel safeguards, and the $1,000 radiator are included.
Improved Hornet towing and rotor-blade pickup.
Adjusted motorcycle tire alignment and rear skid effects, and improved rifle materials.
Included performance fixes and published-release history in Launcher 1.2.2.
Public release on Nexus Mods.
Motorcycle update.
Optional simple flight and automatic hover; gameplay and keybinding tabs in F8.
Aircraft fitting and rotor blade inventory fixes; F8 settings, bindings and personal stats.
Multiplayer aiming, audio and performance updates; Hangar ammunition and airframe changes.
Sights, rifle sounds and handling updates; Hangar and airframe fixes.
Hangar shop update.
Rifle controls, universal rotor blades, Hangar parts shop and 2x sights.
Graphics presets, weapon hotbar, drop position and flashlight shadow fixes.
Sprint aiming fixes, brighter weapon flashlights and zombie patrol movement.
Aiming and inventory fixes, brighter weapon lights and idle zombie wandering.
Weapon aiming and flashlights, backpack drop fixes and more responsive collective.
Smoother flight, collective gauge, backpack storage-drop fix and tougher Mechanic.
Slower Mechanic with immediate pursuit and attack recovery.
Mechanic night hunter.
Flight balance and collective gauge.
Manual flight and engine/turbo performance.
Mod update with Launcher 1.1.
Backpack removal and guest inventory refresh fixes; docking ownership updates.
Separated the player release package from development tools.
Unloading refits original racked blades and frees the trailer for another Hornet.
Rotor-sync actor work deferred to the game tick to address an RPC callback crash.
Owner-only aircraft simulation, multiplayer aircraft identity and blade fitting updates.
Docking collision, delayed attachment and trailer-mass synchronization fixes.
Restored the missing heli-trailer landing pad.
Guest left-click blade attachment and replicated landing pad collision.
Multiplayer aircraft/blade identities and docking synchronization.
Landing pad trim and stopped-engine Hornet audio cleanup.
Hover docking and native towing force fixes.
Native blade removal/refitting and separate Trailer/Heli trailer choices.
Blade pickup alignment and native left-click attachment.
Hornet carrier deck, removable main blades and docking/rack storage.
Hornet radiator and battery mounting positions retained after refitting.
Native input conflict fixes for aircraft vertical movement and banking.
Assisted vertical flight and restored rotor/propeller visibility.
Single-seat Hornet gyrocopter with native servicing and rare airframe spawns.
Imported Hazmat zombie variant with distance detail levels.
Multiplayer backpack lookup and transfer feedback fixes.
